name: r4_sides_write_083
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys
s=Path('src/URMatchingRectangle.lean').read_text().replace('ordered_empty_rectangle','ordered_empty_rectangle_sides').replace('      Disjoint A B ∧','      (∀ x ∈ A, ∃ i, x = e (Sum.inl i)) ∧\n      (∀ y ∈ B, ∃ i, y = e (Sum.inr i)) ∧\n      Disjoint A B ∧').replace('ha, ?_','ha, ?_')
s=s.replace('⟨Finset.univ.image a, Finset.univ.image b, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩','⟨Finset.univ.image a, Finset.univ.image b, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩')
s=s.replace('  · apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr','''  · intro x hx
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hx
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · intro y hy
    obtain ⟨i, _, rfl⟩ := Finset.mem_image.mp hy
    exact ⟨_, rfl⟩
  · apply Finset.disjoint_left.mpr''')
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(Path.cwd()/'write_lane.py'),'src/URMatchingRectangleSides.lean'],input=s,text=True,check=True)
